dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です相談にきてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 17歳女性
dialogue.English: I'm a 17-year-old female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます今日はどうされましたか
dialogue.English: Thank you. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのような事があって学校に行きたくないと思うのか教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what's making you feel like you don't want to go to school?

dialogue.content: なんかクラスに居ても楽しくなくて
dialogue.English: Well, it's just not fun being in my class.

dialogue.content: 行きたくないなと。
dialogue.English: So I don't feel like going.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね楽しくないと学校がつまらなくなっちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. If it's not fun, school can feel really boring, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: では、どんな時に楽しくないと感じますか
dialogue.English: So, when do you feel like it's not fun?

dialogue.content: 休み時間です
dialogue.English: During break time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なぜ休み時間が楽しくないのかを、お話してくれますか
dialogue.English: Could you tell me why break time isn't fun for you?

dialogue.content: いま一緒にいるグループの子と合わなくて、、
dialogue.English: I don't really get along with the kids in my current group...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どんな事が合わないと感じますか
dialogue.English: In what ways do you feel you don't get along?

dialogue.content: 話していても適当な相槌でスマホ見てたりするところです
dialogue.English: Even when I'm talking, they just give half-hearted responses and look at their phones.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねそれは話していても楽しくないですよね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. That wouldn't be very fun to talk to them, would it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: No, it's not.

dialogue.content: グループの他の子が話している時もそんな感じなのですか
dialogue.English: Are they like that when other people in the group are talking too?

dialogue.content: 全体的にそんな感じだと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's pretty much like that for everyone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれでは話を聞いているのかどうかもわからなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be hard to tell if they're even listening, right?

dialogue.content: 興味がないんだろうなってかんじてすね、、
dialogue.English: It feels like they're just not interested...

dialogue.content: うんうん、そう感じてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: グループではいつもどんな話をされるのですか
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do you usually talk about in the group?

dialogue.content: テストの話とか好きなアイドルの話とか、、他の子と同じようなことだと思います
dialogue.English: Things like tests, our favorite idols... I think it's the same kind of stuff other kids talk about.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本当なら一緒に盛り上がりたいところですよね
dialogue.English: Ideally, you'd want to get excited about those things together, right?

dialogue.content: せめて人の話はちゃんと聞こうよって思いますね
dialogue.English: At the very least, I feel they should listen properly when someone is talking.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうですよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I agree.

dialogue.content: 誰からも不満の声とかは上がらない感じですか
dialogue.English: Does it seem like no one else in the group complains about it?

dialogue.content: 誰って誰のことですか？
dialogue.English: Who do you mean by 'no one else'?

dialogue.content: グループの中でですね
dialogue.English: Within your group.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: そうですね、私は聞いたことないです
dialogue.English: Right, I haven't heard anyone say anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねグループ内で離れた所で個別で話をしたりとかはしないですか
dialogue.English: I see. Do you ever step aside and talk one-on-one with someone in the group?

dialogue.content: うーん、話したりしても特別なことは話さないです
dialogue.English: Hmm, even if we do, we don't talk about anything special.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 今のグループの付き合いはまだ浅そうな感じもしたのですが、どうですか
dialogue.English: It sounds like your relationship with the current group might still be fairly new—does that seem right?

dialogue.content: クラス替えからなので、、短いといえば短いかも
dialogue.English: It's been since the classes changed... so I guess you could say it's been a short time.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: だとまだこれから付き合いが深くなっていくような感じでもありますね
dialogue.English: In that case, it's possible your relationships could deepen from here.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、
dialogue.English: Do you think so...?

dialogue.content: これまで今の友達とは違う友達との付き合いの時は、どうでしたか
dialogue.English: How were your friendships in the past, with friends who were different from your current ones?

dialogue.content: すみません、どうってどういうことを聞いているのか分からないです、
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I'm not sure what you mean by 'how were they?'

dialogue.content: わかりづらい表現になってしまっていましたねすみません
dialogue.English: That was an unclear way of putting it. I apologize.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、すみません
dialogue.English: No, no, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 初めはなかなか馴染めなかったなーとか
dialogue.English: Like, maybe it took a while to fit in at first, or something like that.

dialogue.content: グループに馴染めなくてもその中の誰かとは仲良くなれてました。
dialogue.English: Even if I didn't fit in with the whole group, I was always able to become good friends with at least one person in it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねそうしたお友達がいたんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you've had friends like that before.

dialogue.content: グループの中の特定の誰かと気が合うという事はありますもんね
dialogue.English: It's common to connect with one specific person within a group, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 今はその時のお友達と話をする機会はなさそうですか
dialogue.English: Do you not really have opportunities now to talk with those friends from before?

dialogue.content: 中学時代の子とか去年のクラスの子には話せないですね
dialogue.English: I can't really talk to my friends from middle school or last year's class.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね気軽に話せる機会があるといいんですが、それができないと少し寂しくなりますね
dialogue.English: I see. It would be nice to have a chance to talk casually, and it can feel a bit lonely when you can't.

dialogue.content: みんな結局今を生きてるので過去はただの思い出なのかなと思いす
dialogue.English: Everyone is living in the present, so I guess the past is just a memory.

dialogue.content: そう思えているんですね
dialogue.English: That's how you see it.

dialogue.content: 今が楽しい人は過去は過去って思ってるんじゃないかなって思うんですよね
dialogue.English: I think people who are enjoying the present probably think “the past is the past.”

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね、私の個人的な思いとしては、過去は過去だとしても、また繋がる縁もあると思っています
dialogue.English: Well, personally, I think even if the past is the past, there can still be connections that rekindle.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see, I understand.

dialogue.content: そうですね、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やはり心に残る友達というのはまた会いたいと思いますし
dialogue.English: After all, friends who stay in your heart are ones you want to see again.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 確かにそうかもしれない
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: ええ、私はそう思っています
dialogue.English: Yes, that's what I believe.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: もしかしたら今のグループの中でもそういった子が出てくるかもしれませんし、また以前の仲の良い友達と今後交流する機会も出てくるかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Perhaps someone like that will emerge in your current group, or maybe an opportunity to reconnect with your good friends from the past will come up.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、
dialogue.English: Do you think so...?

dialogue.content: ええ、まだ今のグループの子達も様子を伺っているところなのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Yes, it could be that the people in your current group are still just feeling things out.

dialogue.content: 気が合う友達はほしいですもんね
dialogue.English: You want to have friends you can connect with, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: 今のグループでそうした子が見つかるかどうかはわからないですが、これから沢山出会う中でいつか見つかるのではないかと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I don't know if you'll find someone like that in your current group, but I think you'll eventually find someone among the many people you'll meet in the future.

dialogue.content: いま学校に行くのがしんどいのでこれからのことを考える余裕はないです、、
dialogue.English: It's so hard to go to school right now that I don't have the energy to think about the future...

dialogue.content: そうなんですねしんどくなってきてしまっているんですね
dialogue.English: I see, it's become really hard for you.

dialogue.content: だから相談に来ました
dialogue.English: That's why I came to talk.

dialogue.content: 今のグループではない所で、話ができそうなお友達を探してみてはいかがですか
dialogue.English: How about trying to find a friend you could talk to outside of your current group?

dialogue.content: 今まで話をしていないので急に話しかけにくいです
dialogue.English: I haven't talked to anyone else before, so it's hard to suddenly strike up a conversation.

dialogue.content: なかなか声をかけるのも勇気がいる事ですもんね突然は話しかけにくいものですよね
dialogue.English: It takes a lot of courage to approach someone, doesn't it? It's difficult to just suddenly start talking to someone.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: クラスの中でゆっくり様子を見て考えてみてはいかがですか話しやすそうな子がいないかな、とか
dialogue.English: How about taking your time to observe your class and see if there's anyone who looks easy to talk to?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: そうですね、探してみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll try looking.

dialogue.content: クラスの子以外でもいいと思いますよ
dialogue.English: It could be someone outside of your class, too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 本日は相談終了の時間となってしまったのですが、お話してみて気持ちなどはいかがですか
dialogue.English: We've come to the end of our time today. How are you feeling after talking?

dialogue.content: しんどさは変わらないので頑張るしかないなと思いました
dialogue.English: The difficulty hasn't changed, so I feel I just have to hang in there.

dialogue.content: そうですね、話せる友達がいない間は辛いものかもしれませんが、どこで状況が変わるかは誰にもわからないものですし、もしかしたらそれが明日かもしれないですし
dialogue.English: I understand. It can be painful when you don't have friends to talk to, but no one knows when the situation might change. It could even be tomorrow.

dialogue.content: 分かりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: きっと見つかりますよ、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: I'm sure you'll find someone. It'll be okay.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: どんな些細な事でもまたお話に来てくださいね話す中で気持ちが整理されていく事も多いですから
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back and talk anytime, about anything at all. Talking things out often helps to sort through your feelings.

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 時間もかなり過ぎてるのでこれで終わらせてもらいます。
dialogue.English: We're quite a bit over time, so I'll end it here.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、本日はお話を聞かせてくださりありがとうございました。それでは、これで失礼させていただきますね
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for sharing your story with me today. I'll let you go now.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイありがとうございました。時間が過ぎてしまいすみません。。。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. I'm sorry for going over time...)

dialogue.content: （それでは失礼させていただきますね。お疲れ様でした！）
dialogue.English: (Alright, I'll be going now. Great work today!)
